entries.back_en: "Well... Anyway, how do we get to the mainland from here?"
entries.note: 'Um' dropped but tone preserved; meaning intact.

entries.back_en: "Besides, the Pabpab say 'pukapuka'... 'What will be, will be'... It's their way... Dying doesn't seem to bother them much."
"Well, it bothers me! We can't let him die! We'll go get the herbs you need! Where do we find"
entries.note: Target truncated: missing 'them' and the closing question mark.

entries.back_en: "We can't just sit around here waiting, doing nothing. Let us help pay back your hospitality."
"As I was saying, 'pukapuka' is their way. It means what will be, will be... But it also means everything works out in the end."
"Thank you for letting us stay here, Mr. Beyd!"
"The Pabpab seem to know when it's possible to cross the swamps. I don't know how, but they do. Don't worry—when the time comes, they'll take you."
